counties.notes: Shelby County (Memphis and suburbs; FIPS 47157) parcels are published by ReGIS (Regional Geographic Information Systems), the multi-jurisdictional GIS consortium the Shelby County Commission established in 2004 (https://www.shelbycountytn.gov/467/REGIS-Regional-GIS). The atlas lists no endpoint for Shelby: the endpoint was withheld from the atlas on 2026-10-17 pending ReGIS's written consent. The item information published with ReGIS's parcel service says: "This data is owned by Shelby County Government and is for the sole use of ReGIS its participants and their authorized agents. This data may NOT be displayed publicly, sold or transferred to any other entity without the written consent of ReGIS." ReGIS's parcel server also fails a standard TLS handshake: on 2026-10-17 a default client was refused with "unsafe legacy renegotiation disabled", because the server still requires unsafe legacy TLS renegotiation. Contact ReGIS (below) about access.

coverage.summary: ReGIS publishes Shelby County's parcels under terms that bar public display without its written consent, and we don't have that consent yet, so we don't index it. Contact ReGIS, or request it and we'll tell you if that changes.

counties.notes: Hamilton County, Tennessee (Chattanooga; FIPS 47065), not to be confused with Hamilton County, Ohio (Cincinnati, 39061) or Hamilton County, Indiana (18057). The county serves its parcels, as of 2026-11-10, from gis.hamiltontn.gov/server (ArcGIS Server 11.3), Parcels MapServer layer 0; layer 1 is the same parcels as labels. The Live_Parcels service on mapsdev.hamiltontn.gov that this record listed until 2026-11-10 answers HTTP 522 (origin timed out). Read 2026-11-10: 170,205 parcels, OWNERNAME1 on all of them, the owner's mailing street MASTNAME on 170,193, MACITY on 170,201, MAZIP on 170,052 and the site ADDRESS on 170,201; UPPER(OWNERNAME1) LIKE '%SMITH%' returns 2,339, the sample query's predicate. PBA_NUM is the full parcel book and account number with internal spaces ('033157K N 00900P000'); GISLINK is the trimmed parcel ID ('033157K N 00900'). MASTNUM is blank on every row because MASTNAME holds the whole mailing street line, so MASTNUM is not listed. maxRecordCount 2000 with pagination, Map, Query and Data, and the server reflects the caller's Origin for CORS. EXEMPTION COLUMN, NOT LISTED: EXEMPTCODE is not a search field. TERMS: the layer, its service and its item information carry no licence or copyright text; the county's GIS page says parcels are provided by the Office of the Assessor of Property and that the data 'should be viewed only as a representation of reality'.

contact.department: City of Johnson City GIS Division (regional parcel layer covering Sullivan County)

counties.notes: Sullivan County, Tennessee (county seat Blountville; Kingsport and Bristol) has no county-run public REST parcel layer with owner names. Its parcels are carried on the City of Johnson City's regional ParcelPublishing/TaxParcels MapServer layer 0 (Tax Parcels), which also holds Washington, Carter, Unicoi and neighbouring counties. Filter with COUNTYNAME='Sullivan County' (78,958 of the layer's 183,538 rows on 2026-10-03); the plain value 'Sullivan' matches nothing. About 313 Sullivan parcels (GISLINK starting 082) carry a NULL or different COUNTYNAME and fall outside this scope, roughly 0.4 percent; COUNTY_ID=82 catches them but admits 314 rows from outside the county, so the name scope stays. The owner is OWNER (with OWNER2); the parcel ID is GISLINK (e.g. 082029B A 01600) with ID as the display form (029B A 016.00), and PARID is NULL for Sullivan rows. ADDRESS stores the street name first and the house number last (EXAMPLE RD 123), so search on a street word: a number-first LIKE ('%123 EXAMPLE RD%') returns nothing, and only 647 of 78,737 Sullivan addresses start with a digit, so the free tools' address auto-lookup will miss most Sullivan addresses until they retry number-last. The owner mailing address is MAILADDR with MAILCITY, STATE and ZIP. CARDURL links each parcel to the state's TPAD property card. CORS reflects the request Origin (Access-Control-Allow-Origin echoed back, credentials true); a request without an Origin gets no CORS header. maxRecordCount is 2000. LICENCE: RESTRICTED. The ArcGIS item's licence text reads: "Read access only for all city staff. Delivered products are not to be resold by the purchaser for any reason and may not be reproduced without the written permission of the staff of the Johnson City GIS Division." The item and the REST endpoint are public, but the terms restrict resale and reproduction, so the atlas records only the query URL, stores no copy of the layer beyond the short-lived server cache every live query passes through, and serves this county by live query only; Leo reviewed and accepted that exposure on 2026-10-03. The data was last refreshed in October 2025. Sullivan County's own SULLIVAN service on ArcGIS Online has no owner field. The Tennessee Comptroller of the Treasury does publish a statewide property boundaries service (Tennessee_Property_Boundaries_Public_Use, 86 counties), but its description says it is not intended for commercial use, so it is not registered here; we asked the Comptroller for permission on 2026-11-01. Verified live 2026-10-03: owner SMITH returned rows (first row GISLINK 082029B A 01600, with a Kingsport mailing address).

RETIRED 2026-11-13, with the reason: the county's server answers our hosted servers with HTTP 403 every time, so we cannot serve this county. The server (gis.montgomerytn.gov, ArcGIS Server, behind Cloudflare) answers an ordinary home connection with HTTP 200 and the layer's metadata, and that was checked again on 2026-11-13 with a plain request. From the hosted servers this site's liveness probe and lookups run on, every probe on record failed with 403: 1,830 failures and no success. The home connection gets 200 with any User-Agent and the hosted servers get 403 every time, so the block follows where the request comes from, not what it says. A caller on its own machine can still reach the layer directly. Re-register the layer if the county stops blocking cloud hosts. Prior record (Montgomery County, Tennessee; Clarksville; FIPS 47125; verified 2026-10-14): PublicParcels MapServer layer 0 on the Assessor of Property's public GIS server, 99,941 rows on 2026-11-10; registered fields ParcelNo (e.g. 066E A 00600 000), GISLINK (063066E A 00600), PropertyAddress and PropertyCity only. On 2026-11-10 the layer also carried Owner1, Owner2, MailingAddress, MailCity, MailState and MailZip, which the record never listed. Rows are one per building card, not one per parcel, so a parcel with several buildings repeats its parcel id and situs. The layer's wkid is 102736 (Tennessee State Plane, US feet; latestWkid 2274); maxRecordCount 2000 with pagination. No licence or terms are posted on the layer, its service, its item information or the assessor's pages.

coverage.summary: Montgomery County's GIS server answers every request from our hosted servers with HTTP 403 (it blocks cloud hosts) though it answers a home connection, so we can't serve it and don't index it. Use the Assessor's GIS page, or request it and we'll tell you if that changes.
